name: InterContinental Century City Chengdu
positioning: City hotel in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan province, that blends European tradition with Chinese hospitality, next to Guixi Ecological Park and about a kilometer from Chengdu SKP, with spa-like bathrooms, a spa and a lobby tea lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a Chengdu base next to a large park with lakes, woodlands and trails
Guests who value a spa-like bathroom with a separate shower and tub
Visitors who enjoy a tea lounge devoted to the ancient art of tea-drinking

facts.text: The hotel is in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan province.
The hotel blends European tradition with Chinese hospitality.
The hotel neighbors Guixi Ecological Park, a 93-hectare site in Chengdu's Ring Ecological Zone.
Guixi Ecological Park has lakes, woodlands and trails.
Chengdu SKP is about 1 kilometer from the hotel.
Guest rooms and suites have a spa-like bathroom with a separate shower and tub.
The suites include a Presidential Mansion.
A pillow menu is available by request.
Cha Lounge in the lobby focuses on the ancient art of tea-drinking.
La Rotisserie French Restaurant pairs its interior with a 270-degree panoramic outdoor garden.

highlights.text: The hotel neighbors Guixi Ecological Park, a 93-hectare site with lakes, woodlands and trails.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport is about 19 kilometers from the hotel.
